# Rajput Lalit & Associates

> Professional GST, Income Tax, Accounting, TDS, Business Registration and
> Tax Consultancy firm based in Ambala City, Haryana, India. Founded by
> Lalit Rajput. Serves individuals and businesses across India, and NRIs
> worldwide.

## About

Rajput Lalit & Associates provides GST Registration, GST Return Filing,
Income Tax Return Filing, Accounting/Bookkeeping, TDS Return Filing,
MSME Registration, Company Registration, GST Notice Reply and Business
Compliance services. The firm also publishes free calculators and
educational content on GST, Income Tax, TDS and business compliance
topics, primarily for readers in India and NRIs abroad.
